scope: full answers (Apertus rewrite + Apertus 70B answer) for the 230 retrieval-eval questions
number_check_definition: every number written in digits in a sentence must occur in the sources that sentence cites (as shown to the model, digits or FR/DE number words) or in the question; numbers the answer writes as words are not checked
review: all 6 number rejections checked by hand: 4 computed or inferred numbers (sums such as 17 + 22 = 39, a feast day read as a date), 2 numbers cited to the wrong source
